title: In-source NatSpec self-certifies the mandatory-streamer exposure as 'not an audit finding' with no story artefact behind it
fingerprintBasis: sha256(src/StableYieldAccumulator.sol:contract-level NatSpec :73-75:self-certifying-natspec-suppression-claim-with-no-backing-triage-artefact)  [entryPoint null -> legacy hash form, byte-identical to pre-entryPoint findings]
description: NatSpec :73-75 declares failure mode 2 'the accepted consequence of the mandatory-streamer decision, not an audit finding.' No story artefact records any such acceptance: all five [story-026] commit bodies (3e1259b, e7f8a45, 2dc2426, b14522d, f704130) state the design facts but record no acceptance decision; the project CLAUDE.md is silent on the nudge rail; registered-projects.json carries no matching designDecision; the ledger has no entry for the rail. The same block additionally asserts a CLOSED enumeration ('there are three failure modes') that provably omits setRewardToken (run-14 M-01).
impact: None to assets or availability. The impact is on AUDIT ASSURANCE: the comment, if honoured, removes a verified availability defect from the record. It was LOAD-BEARING this run -- had it been honoured, M-01 and F-01 would have been removed at sanitization.
recommendation: Either record the acceptance as a real triage decision (/ledger status, or a registered-projects.json designDecision) and delete the self-exculpating sentence, or drop the claim. If the intent is 'accepted, we will fix it', the correct ledger status is fix-pending, NOT acknowledged — acknowledged suppresses the finding from every future scan precisely when someone is depending on the fix landing.
circularityRuling: UNCONDITIONALLY not suppressible by the artefact it indicts. Suppressing this finding on the strength of the sentence it objects to would let the code under audit adjudicate a finding against itself. Concur with the sanitizer's selfSuppressingClaimRuling in full; no severity discount and no confidence reduction were applied on the strength of the comment either.
triageStatusGuidance: If the owner's intent is 'accepted, we will fix it', the correct ledger status is FIX-PENDING, NEVER acknowledged. acknowledged suppresses the finding from every future scan precisely when someone is depending on the fix landing.
doNotAutoSuppress: Do NOT auto-suppress or auto-close anything on the strength of src/StableYieldAccumulator.sol:73-77. Acceptance must be a REAL /ledger triage decision.

validity.note: Low, not QA, is correct: an active suppression attempt that was load-bearing for THIS run is above the informational floor.
